name: Phase 1 — Interactive Map UI + Asset Plotting

content.description: Build Leaflet-based interactive map page at /tracking that plots ports (from mdm_ports), vessels (from iot_vessel_positions), and containers (from iot_container_gps_trackings). Includes layer filters, side panel asset list, detail view on click, refresh button, and leaflet CSS loading.
capabilities: Full-screen Leaflet map with OpenStreetMap tiles centered on Qatar (25.3°N, 51.5°E)
Port markers (slate anchor icons) from mdm_ports with lat/lng
Vessel markers (blue ship icons) from iot_vessel_positions with popups showing name/IMO/speed/course/destination/ETA
Container markers (green box icons) from iot_container_gps_trackings with popups showing number/type/speed/device/battery
Layer filter toggle bar: All | Vessels | Containers | Ports — with counts
Right side panel: asset list grouped by type, click to select and fly-to on map
Detail panel: click marker or list item to see full details with close button
Refresh button: client-side fetch to /api/v1/tracking/map-data to update positions
Status bar showing live tracking status and asset counts
Loading skeleton while page data loads
Leaflet CSS loaded properly (link tag or import)
acceptance_criteria: GET /tracking shows full-screen map with proper Leaflet tiles rendering
Ports with lat/lng from mdm_ports appear as slate markers on map with popup on click
Vessels from iot_vessel_positions appear as blue markers with popup showing name, IMO, MMSI, speed, course, nav status, destination, ETA
Containers from iot_container_gps_trackings appear as green markers with popup showing number, type, speed, device ID, battery level
Layer filter buttons toggle which markers are visible
Side panel lists all assets grouped by type with click-to-select behavior
Clicking a marker or list item shows detail panel and flies map to that position
Refresh button calls GET /api/v1/tracking/map-data and updates markers without page reload
CSP in next.config.ts updated: img-src includes *.tile.openstreetmap.org, connect-src includes *.tile.openstreetmap.org
Leaflet CSS loads correctly — no broken tile layout or missing marker styles
Auth check: requires iot:read permission, redirects to / if denied
Server Component page fetches data, passes to client TrackingDashboard
Map component uses dynamic import with ssr:false (Leaflet needs window/document)
edge_cases: No ports have lat/lng — map shows no port markers, empty port section in side panel
No vessel positions exist — vessels section shows 0 count, no vessel markers
No container GPS data — containers section shows 0 count, no container markers
All three empty — side panel shows 'No tracking data' empty state with configuration hint
Port with lat but no lng — filtered out (both required)
Very large number of markers (200+ limit applied server-side)
Map resize on window resize — invalidateSize() called
Selected marker that disappears after refresh — deselect gracefully
error_handling: Leaflet fails to load — show 'Loading map...' fallback indefinitely
Refresh API call fails — silently ignore, keep existing data displayed
User without iot:read permission — redirect to / (not 403 page)
Database query timeout — Next.js error boundary handles it
affected_files: src/components/tracking/tracking-map.tsx — Leaflet map component (client, dynamic import)
src/app/(dashboard)/tracking/page.tsx — Server Component, fetches data, renders TrackingDashboard
src/app/(dashboard)/tracking/tracking-dashboard.tsx — Client component with filters, side panel, map
next.config.ts — Update CSP for OpenStreetMap tiles
src/app/layout.tsx — Add Leaflet CSS link tag
